hooks.name: player_ready_arrow
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerReadyArrow)

rust_summary: The server player's selected bow projectile (`native_player_ready_arrow`).
doc_summary: A server player released a drawn bow with `native_player_ready_arrow(player, name, arrow)`: the name of the selected projectile item. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_ready_arrow@.
